label: UK workplace pension
field.name: Name
field.remainingLumpSumAllowance: Available tax-free allowance allocated to this pot
field.schemeAccessDate: Later access date set by your scheme
option.once: Withdraw the whole pot in one payment
option.monthly: Take monthly payments from the pot
option.minimum: First eligible date in the plan
help.birthDay: Leave blank to use the last day of your birth month.
help.capital: Enter the amount in your pot that has yet to be accessed.
help.pay: Enter pay for the period you are a member of a qualifying-earnings scheme with relief at source. Use zero for a pot with no new contributions.
help.contributionFrom: Use the first eligible payroll date or leave blank for the plan start.
help.contributionUntil: The first date with no further contributions. Leave blank to continue.
help.return: Use a nominal return after fund and scheme charges.
help.payoutMode: Check that your provider offers uncrystallised funds pension lump sums (UFPLS) in the selected form.
help.allowance: Use the smaller of your available lump sum allowance and lump sum and death benefit allowance. If modeling several pots, allocate the available allowance across them once.
help.schemeAccessDate: Leave blank for the normal minimum pension age of 55 before 6 April 2028 and 57 from that date.
help.start: An early start moves to the first permitted date. Milestone withdrawals post at month end.
invalid.person: Select an individual and check the birth month and day.
invalid.contribution: Enter valid contribution dates with an end after the start.
invalid.start: Enter a valid scheme access date or choose a valid age, date or milestone.
